description: The structured report Apprised.news publishes each day (what /api/get-report serves), trimmed to a bounded size with the URL of the full page. type "intel" (default): the cross-desk Daily Intelligence Report (executive summary, threat assessment, key developments, trending entities, sentiment, watch list). type "local": the Local Wire report on U.S. state and local press; each cross-validated story carries sources_listed and independent_origins, counting republished or syndicated copies of one article once and several articles from one website once, and a confidence capped to LOW when fewer than 2 independent origins remain. AI-generated analysis, not news reporting.

cadence.description: daily (the default), or a retrospective: weekly (dated Mondays), monthly (the 1st), quarterly (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct 1), yearly (Jan 1).

date.description: "latest" (the default) or one UTC date as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: get_daily_report
